reponse: No internal salary band for the Austin Support Engineer appears here: the job description and the H2 hiring plan both point to a comp sheet instead [1][5], and Northpeak's recruiter was still asking Carla to share the band on 16 November [4]. The only figure is a general market estimate of $75,000–$95,000 base for a Tier 2 fintech support engineer in Austin with 3–5 years' experience, which the source itself says is not the company's band [2]. The ₪40–47k/month gross band approved on 13 November covers the senior SRE in Tel Aviv, a different role and location [3].
